mission.title: Into the Crosshairs
mission.description: Defend the Merovingian's programs from Anome's followers.

phase.briefing: {player}! You're needed urgently -- it seems some of the Merovingian's programs are under attack. You must save them -- or, at the very least, destroy the fools who think they can attack us with impunity.

enter.say: I'm reading a bunch of signals in there. Get ready!

done.say: Ouch -- so much for the rescue.

phase.briefing:
How unfortunate. Most importantly, though, you destroyed those fools attacking us.
But why are Anome's hooligans coming after us? Why would they--
Hold on, {player}. You're not finished dragging your knuckles just yet. It seems that another location is under attack. Take care of it.

enter.say:
Another load of enemies, and... some sort of weird code signature. I don't know what's up with that. No big puzzle who's going to be in there, though.
It looks like the remaining Exiles are locked in a room in there. Better finish off the attackers first.

phase.briefing:
Let's not even act surprised now.
Yes, more of them attacking. Really, you'd think they'd learn, but no...
The area has been evacuated; however, I believe they may be after some sort of data. Destroy them all.

enter.say: Definitely no allies in here, so have at it!

done.say: Before you take off, take a look around and see if you can find anything useful in there.
You'd better upload that disk so we can check out the contents.

objective.text: Upload the disk at a hardline

mission.finish:
Let me see... Ha! How amusing. Listen to this:
The stupid Frenchman thinks he can help them save her? The longer she's in there, the longer we keep more of those Zion idiots off our backs. Everyone do everything they can to keep it from happening. Take 'em all out.
So... what you just faced was everything they had!? Ha! This is too rich, {player}. Looks like we won't have much trouble with them after all.
